contexts.text: (The Spirits of the moon) are dwarfs. SE 3242.
They did not appear like (ordinary) locusts, but as pigmies, or dwarfs... That, by the ancients, dwarfs were called locusts. Illustrated.
In your eyes, they who are here are like dwarfs.
They who are (in Saturn) are described as dwarfs; their height scarcely reaching beyond my loins; yet corpulent.
The cloth was unloosed, and a multitude of small human bodies were seen to go out, being those whom the evil spirits had carried off... But the dwarfs were seen to escape therefrom...
